SoccerVision: • Developed an end-to-end AI system for automated football match highlight generation • Implemented computer vision models to detect key events (goals, penalties, freekicks etc.) • Generated multiple highlight types (full match, event-based, match summaries) from raw footage • Integrated APIs for payments, authentication and social media sharing.
QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Vision Language Mod: • Fine-tuned the vision-language model Qwen Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct using QLoRA for document image to Markdown conversion. • Applied parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques including 4-bit quantization, LoRA adapters, gradient accumulation, and GPU-based training on Kaggle.
Masked Auto Encoder (MAE): • Built a self-supervised MAE using ViT (Base + Small) for image reconstruction • Applied 75% patch masking and asymmetric encoder–decoder design • Optimized training with mixed precision on dual T4 GPUs (Kaggle)
Custom Diffusion Model for Image Generat: • Implemented a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) in PyTorch using a custom U-Net architecture for high-resolution image generation and reconstruction from noisy inputs. • Developed the complete forward and reverse diffusion pipeline, including noise scheduling, timestep embeddings, mixed-precision training, and image quality evaluation using PSNR and SSIM metri
Image Captioning System: • Built a multimodal image captioning model using ResNet50 + LSTM (Seq2Seq) • Extracted and cached 2048-d image features to optimize training
Traffic Sign Detection & Classification: • Built a computer vision pipeline using YOLO and CNN models for detection and classification tasks • Fine Tuned models on traffic signs dataset
Activites, Honour and Awards: 6x Deans List, FAST NUCES Chiniot-Faisalabad AI & Computer Network TA, FAST NUCES Chiniot-Faisalabad 99.3 Percentile in NSCT TEST, NUCES, HEC 3 rd Positon FPSC coding competition, FAST NUCES Chiniot-Faisalabad
